messages:
nina-cs: SwissCare requested a short Zurich-focused pilot next Wed 08:00-09:30 UTC. They want a temporary QPS increase + Zurich-edge allowlist and, crucially, a transient peering pin because their corporate proxy requires EU-Switzerland routing. renewal flagged as at-risk; success here influences the renewal convo. can infra support?
omar-sre: please send org id, peak qps, and CIDRs. Also confirm whether hosted can accept the peering pin or if they need a Dedicated trial. tagging @ops-oncall.
nina-cs: Hosted PAYG. org id org-sc-504. requested peak qps 1,300 (baseline ~170). CIDRs: 185.60.120.0/24, 185.60.121.0/24. window 2026-08-11T08:00:00Z -> 2026-08-11T09:30:00Z. target p95 < 280ms.
lisette-platform: we can preference eu-central-2 (zurich) and add those CIDRs to the proxy allowlist. note: Hosted defaults to multi-region; for strict Switzerland routing we need a transient routing pin + peering handshake. recommend soft cap 1.5k qps and circuit-break 1.9k. will enable prefix caching for main prompts.
omar-sre: plan: create temp policy + allowlist + transient route pin, enable KV cache warm and telemetry. soft limit 1500 qps, circuit-break 1900. I'll open ticket and reserve burst pool. snippet I'll apply below (informal):
```json
{
  "org_id": "org-sc-504",
  "start": "2026-08-11T08:00:00Z",
  "end": "2026-08-11T09:30:00Z",
  "max_qps": 1500,
  "circuit_break_qps": 1900,
  "allowlist": ["185.60.120.0/24","185.60.121.0/24"],
  "route_pin": "eu-central-2"
}
```
infra-bot: ticket #CS-10421 created -> temp policy + allowlist + transient route pin. assigned to omar-sre. auto-revoke scheduled at end time.
ops-oncall: capacity confirmed in eu-central-2 for the window; reserving burst nodes. will enable token-level tracing and a short-lived dashboard and post checks to #release-war-room. please ensure customer uses ephemeral keys for demo traffic.
matt-ae: i'll attend the demo and the renewal call. nina please share the test prompt set and success KPIs so we can track during the session.
nina-cs: sent prewarm checklist to customer; asked them to rotate keys and run a smoke test at 07:30 UTC. will collect post-demo feedback via the form and forward any UX notes for renewal.
omar-sre: policy pushed -> policy_id=tmp-sc-504-20260811. allowlist applied and route_pin active. dashboard: https://console.redwood.example/org/org-sc-504/session-20260811
ops-oncall: standing by during window; will post 15-min status updates and escalate on latency >320ms or any 5xx spike.
nina-cs: thanks all  fingers crossed :crossed_fingers:
